name: Aurora Power & Design Inc.
old_description: We've been in the solar energy business since 1985. As one of the oldest renewable energy companies in the country, we have the edge on solar power. You can depend on us to keep you updated with the most modern, efficient solar power equipment.
about:
Aurora Power & Design Inc. has operated from Boise, Idaho since 1985, making it one of the longest-standing renewable energy firms in the United States. The company was founded to bring solar power solutions to the Intermountain West and has remained a local presence for nearly four decades.

The firm supplies and installs complete solar energy systems for both residential and commercial customers. Its offerings span solar panel sales, battery storage banks, hydropower solutions, and generator hookups. Technicians take a holistic approach to system design, selecting equipment matched to a site’s size and layout and positioning arrays for maximum sun exposure. The company does not disclose its facility size, headcount, or annual project volume.

Aurora serves homeowners and businesses throughout the Boise area seeking to reduce grid dependence or lower energy costs. Typical projects include rooftop and ground-mount photovoltaic arrays for houses, offices, and agricultural operations, as well as off-grid power packages that combine solar, hydro, and backup generation. The company also works with customers interested in hydropower and generator integration.

Aurora emphasizes its longevity as a differentiator, stating that its 1985 founding gives it an edge in sourcing modern, efficient solar equipment. The firm’s stated goal is to help clients “get off the grid” and achieve energy independence through systems that often pay for themselves within a few years.
